title: The inter-OP layer
tagline: The inter-OP Layer is the intersection of OP L2's, think of it like a roundtable
description: While initially, an OP-Stack fork, the Inter-OP layer became a set of utility contracts that aim to enhance interoperability on top of the OP-Stack, the two main components are the L1Multi Standard Bridge, and the L1 to L2 Create 2 deployer, both of which build heavily on top of the OP-Contracts, as well as lightly inspired by other well known projects.
how_its_made:
Building on the bedrock contracts, and experimenting on chain and off-chain, we built utils that seek to help any dev or user wanting to build or use the superchain, by giving them a set of utils that can bring forth any contract for any OP L2 they wish to interact with, all within the same contract.

We also built out various functionalities/simulation functions, and entire contracts that would help make our lives easier, which certainly helped define the objectives early on, though the time was tight, we made it to the finale and that were glad for!
